topic.name: 军事、安全与突发事件
topic.description: 追踪冲突、军备、公共安全和仍在发展的重大事件

overview: 今日专题“军事、安全与突发事件”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: PM, Coalition and crossbench support Jacqui Lambie after Pauline Hanson cartoon mocked vaginal prolapse
items.summary: One Nation leader said Tasmanian senator should ‘get over it’ and claimed the cartoon was ‘satirical’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Anthony Albanese has praised the courage of Jacqui Lambie in speaking out about her struggles with vaginal prolapse, as politicians from across the spectrum condemn a One Nation cartoon. The latest cartoon, part of Pauline Hanson’s Please Explain series, depicts the army veteran as saying “I can’t laugh because of my prolapsed vagina,” before adding a crude sound effect ridiculing the health condition. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚总理及跨党派议员支持杰基·兰比，谴责宝琳·汉森漫画嘲讽其子宫脱垂
items.summaryZh: 宝琳·汉森领导的“单一民族党”发布漫画嘲讽参议员杰基·兰比的子宫脱垂病情，引发政界广泛谴责。澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯称赞兰比公开讨论个人健康问题的勇气，并批评了该漫画的粗俗行为。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于政治话语底线及对女性健康问题尊重程度的全国性讨论。

items.title: US prize-winning cancer scientist Wan Fengyi joins China’s Zhejiang University
items.summary: A Johns Hopkins University scientist whose award-winning work suggests that a brief stomach bug could raise the risk of colon cancer has moved to China full time. Wan Fengyi, a professor at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, has joined Zhejiang University in Hangzhou, according to his new profile on the Chinese university’s website. Wan returned to China this month and now holds a chair professorship at Zhejiang University. He is based at a national laboratory at its Second...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 美籍获奖癌症科学家万丰义加入中国浙江大学
items.summaryZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学教授万丰义已全职回国，加入浙江大学担任讲席教授。他的研究曾指出胃部感染可能增加结肠癌风险。
items.whyImportant: 此举体现了中国在吸引顶尖科研人才回流以加强国内生物医学研究方面的持续努力。

items.title: Trump defends Russian sanctions relief, lashes out at Zelenskyy
items.summary: US president accuses Ukrainian leader of not wanting to end the war, as Zelenskyy speaks with Washington envoys.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 特朗普为放宽对俄制裁辩护，抨击泽连斯基
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普指责乌克兰领导人无意结束战争。此前，泽连斯基曾与华盛顿特使进行会谈。
items.whyImportant: 美乌领导人之间的公开分歧可能预示着美国对乌政策及俄乌冲突走向的重大调整。

items.title: Zelensky seeks to ease US tensions as Trump accuses him of stalling peace
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke with top US envoys Sunday to try to ease tensions, as Donald Trump accused his counterpart of not wanting to end the war with Russia. Zelensky spoke to US officials Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner as both Russia and Ukraine hit each other’s energy sites, with Moscow leaving thousands without power and Kyiv carrying out the largest drone attack on St Petersburg since the start of the war in 2022. Trump and Zelensky have clashed as the US president...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基寻求缓解美乌紧张关系，特朗普指责其拖延和平进程
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基与美国高级特使会谈，试图缓解因特朗普指责其不愿结束战争而产生的紧张局势。与此同时，俄乌双方近期加大了对彼此能源设施的打击力度。
items.whyImportant: 美乌高层关系的波动直接影响到俄乌冲突的走向及国际援助的稳定性。

items.title: Trump endorses ‘great warrior’ Netanyahu as tight Israeli election looms
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Sunday endorsed his ally Benjamin Netanyahu as the long-time Israeli prime minister struggles for an edge in next week’s parliamentary election. Trump praised Netanyahu as a “great warrior prime minister” and peace partner, crediting him with joining the United States in launching strikes on Iran in February. The conflict, in its seventh month, has disrupted energy markets globally and wreaked havoc across the Middle East, damaging critical infrastructure and...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 特朗普在以色列大选前夕背书“伟大的战士”内塔尼亚胡
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普公开支持其盟友内塔尼亚胡，称其为“伟大的战士总理”及和平伙伴。内塔尼亚胡正面临下周议会选举的严峻挑战，此前他曾与美国共同对伊朗发动打击。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过外交背书影响以色列大选走向，并凸显美以两国在地区冲突中的紧密立场。

items.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon told officer friend ‘I love you’ and ‘not everything in the news is true’ after arrest, court told
items.summary: Accused asked fellow police officer how law enforcement would respond to reports of gunshots days before alleged murders, court hears Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon allegedly told a friend “I love you’” and “not everything in the news is true” a month after he was arrested over a double murder, a court has heard. Lamarre-Condon, 31, has been accused of fatally shooting Sydney couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 法庭获悉：博·拉马尔-康登在被捕后曾对警员朋友称“我爱你”并暗示新闻不实
items.summaryZh: 涉嫌谋杀悉尼情侣的警员博·拉马尔-康登被指在案发前曾询问同事关于枪击案的应对程序。法庭听取证词称，他在被捕一个月后仍向朋友坚称新闻报道并非完全属实。
items.whyImportant: 此案涉及现役警员利用职权犯罪，引发了公众对执法人员行为准则及司法公正的关注。

items.summary: Fast-moving grass fire caused Canada’s military base tragedy

items.titleZh: 快速蔓延的草火导致加拿大军事基地悲剧
items.summaryZh: 加拿大一处军事基地发生火灾，调查显示快速蔓延的草火是导致此次悲剧的主要原因。目前相关部门正在评估损失及事故细节。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了军事设施在极端天气和自然灾害面前的脆弱性。

items.title: Zelenskyy thanks Trump for resumed intelligence sharing after US Starlink ‘message’
items.summary: Two people killed and at least 17 injured as Russia and Ukraine continue to trade strikes on power infrastructure Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Sunday thanked the Trump administration for resuming intelligence sharing between the two countries, but maintained the US had intentionally throttled its Starlink satellite internet access so that Donald Trump could send a “message” in his ongoing feud with the Ukrainian president. In an interview on NBC, Zelenskyy said the US had “unblocked” intelligence on impending Russian ballistic missile strikes, which have pounded the country’s energy infrastructure as winter draws in. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基感谢特朗普恢复情报共享，称美方曾限制星链以示“警告”
items.summaryZh: 泽连斯基感谢特朗普政府恢复情报共享，但同时指出美方此前曾故意限制乌克兰的星链服务以表达不满。目前俄乌双方在能源基础设施上的打击行动仍在持续。
items.whyImportant: 美乌之间在关键技术和情报支持上的博弈，反映了双方在战争策略上的复杂互动。

items.title: Lula and Bolsonaro spar in Brazil’s fiery first presidential run-off debate
items.summary: Brazil’s Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva traded barbs in ⁠their first face-to-face presidential debate on Sunday in a contentious back-and-forth just one week before the election’s run-off. Polls before the debate suggested Bolsonaro, the son of former far-right president Jair Bolsonaro, would enter the October 25 vote as the favourite after finishing nearly two points ahead of Lula in the election’s first round earlier this month. But surveys have also shown a...
items.titleZh: 卢拉与博索纳罗在巴西总统大选首场决选辩论中激烈交锋
items.summaryZh: 巴西总统卢拉与参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗在决选前夕进行了首次面对面辩论，双方言辞激烈。民调显示博索纳罗在首轮投票后略占优势，选情十分胶着。
items.whyImportant: 此次辩论是决定巴西未来政治走向的关键节点，选民的投票意向将直接影响国家政策方向。

items.title: Saudi closes Riyadh skyscraper as chopper pilots killed near Yemen
items.summary: Riyadh’s Kingdom Centre skyscraper ordered remote working for office tenants on Sunday following repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, as the Saudi-led coalition said two pilots were killed in a crash near the Yemen border. The imposing, 99-storey landmark announced “mandatory” remote working until further notice. No reason was given for the order, but it comes a week after 13 people were killed in a major Houthi attack on Riyadh’s international airport. The Saudi coalition’s decade-plus war...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 沙特关闭利雅得摩天大楼，也门边境直升机坠毁致飞行员丧生
items.summaryZh: 由于胡塞武装近期频繁袭击，沙特利雅得王国中心大厦已要求租户居家办公。此外，沙特领导的联军证实两名飞行员在也门边境的坠机事故中丧生。
items.whyImportant: 地区安全局势的恶化对沙特境内的商业活动及军事行动造成了直接威胁。

items.title: Inside the shadowy world of anti-Putin sabotage from within Russia
items.summary: Two men tell of the work they say they have been doing to support Ukrainian intelligence during the war.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 深入俄罗斯境内的反普京破坏活动阴影世界
items.summaryZh: 两名男子讲述了他们在俄罗斯境内为支持乌克兰情报部门所进行的破坏活动。这些行动揭示了俄国内部存在的隐秘反战与破坏力量。
items.whyImportant: 此类内部破坏活动增加了俄乌冲突的复杂性，并对俄罗斯国内安全构成潜在挑战。

items.title: GCC condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia as Yemen fighting intensifies
items.summary: Gulf ministers urge action against Houthis as fighting displaces more than 233,000 people across Yemen.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 海湾合作委员会谴责胡塞武装袭击沙特，也门冲突加剧
items.summaryZh: 海湾国家部长敦促对胡塞武装采取行动。也门境内的战斗已导致超过23.3万人流离失所。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了也门局势的持续动荡及其对地区安全和人道主义状况的严重影响。

items.title: India needs more fighter jets. It cannot build them fast enough
items.summary: India has a soaring ambition to modernise its air force, built around a fleet of domestically developed fighter jets. Yet production of these aircraft has been hampered by engine delays and other bottlenecks that defence analysts say could limit its ability to fight future air wars. On October 11 at an airbase in Jodhpur, Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh strapped into a Tejas jet for the last time. It was his final fighter sortie before retiring later this month and he flew it in an Indian-built jet...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 印度急需更多战斗机，但产能难以跟上需求
items.summaryZh: 印度致力于通过国产战斗机实现空军现代化，但发动机延迟和生产瓶颈阻碍了这一进程。防务分析人士认为，这些问题可能限制印度应对未来空战的能力。
items.whyImportant: 产能不足可能削弱印度的国防现代化进程及其在地区安全中的战略威慑力。

items.title: Left paralysed after crash, Hong Kong Keeta rider caught in insurance limbo
items.summary: After a traffic accident on a delivery run for Keeta left courier Joe* paralysed, his world has shrunk to the view of the ceiling above his hospital bed in Hong Kong. The tragedy took place in May when the 54-year-old motorcyclist was momentarily distracted on the road by a notification from the Keeta app reminding him to accept an order, and he collided with a car in front. Despite undergoing major surgery, Joe sustained irreversible neck injuries that left his body and limbs paralysed,...
items.titleZh: 香港Keeta外卖员车祸瘫痪，陷入保险理赔困境
items.summaryZh: 一名54岁的Keeta外卖员在送餐途中因查看手机通知发生车祸，导致全身瘫痪。目前他正面临保险理赔方面的法律和经济困境。
items.whyImportant: 该案例凸显了零工经济中外卖骑手的职业安全保障及保险覆盖范围的法律盲区。

items.title: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
items.summary: The boss of one of Ukraine's biggest steel companies says the country has been "bundled together" in measures aimed at curbing cheap imports.
items.titleZh: 乌克兰钢铁业负责人称欧盟针对中国的关税措施波及乌克兰
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰一家大型钢铁公司的负责人表示，欧盟为限制廉价进口而采取的贸易措施将乌克兰也涵盖在内，对其造成了负面影响。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了全球贸易保护主义措施在复杂的地缘政治背景下可能对盟友经济产生意外的连带伤害。

items.title: China slams Japan’s Takaichi over Yasukuni ritual offering, warns of ‘remilitarisation’
items.summary: China has condemned Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi for sending a ritual offering to Tokyo’s war-linked Yasukuni Shrine, a move that threatens to further strain ties between the neighbours. At the start of Yasukuni’s three-day autumn festival on Saturday, Takaichi sent a ritual tree-stand offering to the shrine in her capacity as prime minister, although she did not visit in person. Minoru Kiuchi, minister in charge of economic growth strategy, visited the controversial site the same day,...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 中国抨击日本首相高市早苗向靖国神社供奉祭品，警告其“再军事化”
items.summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗在靖国神社秋季大祭期间供奉了祭品，引发中国强烈谴责。中方警告此举可能加剧地区紧张局势并暗示日本存在“再军事化”倾向。
items.whyImportant: 历史问题依然是中日关系中的敏感点，此类行为容易引发外交摩擦并影响双边关系的改善。

items.title: The human touch behind the virtual technology for preparing child cancer patients
items.summary: Hong Kong Polytechnic University professor Shara Lee Wee-yee has been using a mixed reality programme to reduce the fear and uncertainty children face before radiotherapy, with personalised rehearsals that allow families to experience the treatment journey before entering hospital. The simulation programme, HEROCARE, was also a tool that helped carers understand what to expect and for future radiotherapists to develop the empathy and communication skills that patient care required, she...
items.titleZh: 虚拟技术背后的温情：香港助力儿童癌症患者适应治疗
items.summaryZh: 香港理工大学教授李慧仪开发了名为HEROCARE的混合现实程序，帮助儿童患者及其家属在放疗前进行模拟体验。该项目旨在减轻患儿恐惧，并培养放射治疗师的同理心与沟通技巧。
items.whyImportant: 该技术展示了医疗科技在提升患者心理健康和改善医患沟通方面的积极应用前景。

items.title: Outrage after Meta suspends No Kings Instagram account during protests
items.summary: ‘Meta owes us an explanation,’ group says as organizers fear censorship after account goes dark for several hours The coalition leaders behind nationwide pro-democracy protests that have drawn millions of Americans to the streets in recent years were frustrated when its Instagram account was temporarily shut down during its latest demonstration on Saturday. The No Kings movement’s account went dark for several hours while protests focused on increasing early voter turnout were underway, sparking censorship fears. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: Meta在抗议期间封禁“无王权”组织Instagram账号引发愤怒
items.summaryZh: 美国民主抗议组织“无王权”在周六的示威活动期间，其Instagram账号被Meta平台暂时封禁。组织者对此表示强烈不满，并担忧这反映了社交媒体平台对政治活动的审查。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对于大型科技公司在敏感政治时期干预言论自由和抗议组织能力的广泛讨论。

items.title: Obama condemns comments by ‘border czar’ that Ilhan Omar could ‘of course’ be denaturalized
items.summary: Ex-president urges Americans to defend congresswoman, saying ‘there’s no reason to believe it will stop with her’ Former US president Barack Obama condemned comments by Donald Trump’s “border czar” that the Republican presidential administration could “of course” strip Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar of her citizenship and deport her. Obama wrote Sunday morning, on X, that “the full weight of the federal government is being brought down on a law-abiding elected official because she has dared to criticize the president.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 奥巴马谴责“边境沙皇”关于剥夺伊尔汗·奥马尔公民身份的言论
items.summaryZh: 前总统奥巴马公开谴责特朗普政府官员称可剥夺民主党众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔公民身份并将其驱逐的言论。奥巴马批评此举是利用联邦权力打压批评总统的民选官员。
items.whyImportant: 此争议凸显了美国政坛在移民政策、公民权利及政治报复问题上的严重对立。

items.title: Qian Jiang, former Johns Hopkins’ eye institute expert, joins hospital in China
items.summary: Professor Qian Jiang, a senior eye expert at Johns Hopkins University in the United States, has moved back to China full time to pursue research on eye transplants. For more than two decades, Qian built and ran the genetic data hub at Johns Hopkins’ renowned Wilmer Eye Institute. He was welcomed at a ceremony on October 5 at Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital in Hangzhou, part of Zhejiang University, the hospital said. At the ceremony, Qian said he would also work on “virtual cells” – computer models...
items.titleZh: 前约翰霍普金斯大学眼科专家钱江全职回国加入中国医院
items.summaryZh: 曾在约翰霍普金斯大学威尔默眼科研究所工作二十余年的资深专家钱江教授，现已全职回国加入浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院。他将致力于眼科移植研究及“虚拟细胞”计算机模型开发。
items.whyImportant: 此举体现了中国在吸引海外顶尖科研人才回流以提升国内医疗科研水平方面的持续努力。

items.title: Major fire at Canada military base leaves four dead, dozens injured
items.summary: Prime Minister Carney said military and emergency crews fought the flames throughout the night in "some of the worst conditions imaginable".
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 加拿大军事基地发生重大火灾，造成四人死亡、数十人受伤
items.summaryZh: 加拿大一处军事基地发生严重火灾，总理卡尼表示救援人员在极端恶劣的条件下进行了彻夜扑救。事故目前已导致四人死亡，数十人受伤。
items.whyImportant: 此次重大安全事故对加拿大军事设施的应急管理能力及人员安全保障提出了严峻考验。

items.title: Protesters disrupt Ben-Gvir event forcing him off stage
items.summary: Israeli protesters disrupted a Tel Aviv university event featuring far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 抗议者扰乱本-格维尔的活动，迫使其离开舞台
items.summaryZh: 以色列极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔在特拉维夫大学出席活动时，遭到现场抗议者的强烈干扰。抗议活动导致现场秩序混乱，迫使本-格维尔被迫中断演讲并离开舞台。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了以色列国内对于现任政府极右翼政策的强烈社会分歧与抗议情绪。

items.title: Warning signs could predict inflammatory bowel disease a decade before diagnosis
items.summary: Antibody patterns in the blood may help doctors identify people at risk so they can be treated earlier, research shows Patterns of antibodies in people’s blood could predict the onset of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) a decade before diagnosis, according to research that raises hopes for catching the condition early. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, the two main forms of IBD, are typically treated only after symptoms appear, when the gut has already been damaged. But scientists found that the immune system sends warning signals up to a decade before diagnosis, paving the way for potentially earlier detection and even prevention. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 研究发现炎症性肠病在确诊前十年即可通过预警信号预测
items.summaryZh: 最新研究表明，人体血液中的抗体模式可在炎症性肠病（IBD）确诊前十年发出预警。这一发现有望改变克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎的治疗模式，实现早期检测与预防。
items.whyImportant: 该研究为炎症性肠病的早期干预提供了科学依据，可能显著改善患者的长期预后。
